LightningComponentBundle.description: Dynamic map driven by a List View with custom center and zoom.

property.name: listViewDeveloperName
property.label: List View Developer Name
property.description: The API Name of the Fleet Asset list view to display.

property.name: centerLatitude
property.label: Default Center Latitude
property.description: Latitude to center the map on.

property.name: centerLongitude
property.label: Default Center Longitude
property.description: Longitude to center the map on.

property.name: zoomLevel
property.label: Default Zoom Level
property.description: The zoom level of the map (1-20).
